registry_layers.source_of_truth: lock-derived mirror index with digest-checked interop loader metadata and cache entries
registry_layers.claim_boundary: air-gapped local package restore evidence only

registry_layers.source_of_truth: release manifest, update manifest, and package-channel manifest
registry_layers.claim_boundary: replayable metadata for package publication planning
hosted registry, network fetch, auth, moderation, and availability claims fail closed

publication_rules: registry metadata must be generated from the lock and mirror evidence
publication metadata may not introduce package identities absent from the lock graph
registry metadata must preserve package manifest digests, language version, ABI identity, and trust signatures from the lock
local registry indexes must preserve exact locked target versions, dependency source authority digests, dependency source digests, package manifest digests, and replay commands
interop loader metadata must fail closed when the mirror digest differs from the generated lock
offline restore receipts must fail closed when any mirror cache entry is missing, extra, or digest-mismatched
hosted-registry behavior must fail closed when claimed without checked-in source authority
release and update metadata may reference package ecosystem artifacts only as generated local evidence
offline mirror publication must remain usable without network access

registry_publication_owner.claim_boundary: local generated registry metadata only; hosted registry availability and package-manager parity are release-blocking overclaims

blocking_conditions: publication metadata contains an unlocked package identity
registry index dependency version or source-authority drift did not fail closed
offline mirror metadata digest mismatch did not fail closed
offline mirror cache payload mismatch did not fail closed
offline mirror validation requires network access
registry index is hand-authored instead of generated
release/update metadata drifts from package ecosystem evidence
registry publication owner contract is missing

release_blocking_conditions: publication metadata contains an unlocked package identity
registry index dependency version or source-authority drift did not fail closed
publication metadata drops package manifest or trust metadata
offline mirror metadata digest mismatch did not fail closed
offline mirror cache payload mismatch did not fail closed
offline mirror validation requires network access
registry index is hand-authored instead of generated
release/update metadata drifts from package ecosystem evidence
